mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ClubOwnerRequest(cor_request_num, cor_content, cor_requestdate, cor_status, memberIdx) VALUES(cor_request_seq.NEXTVAL, #{cor_content}, SYSDATE, #{cor_status}, #{memberIdx})
mapper.select: SELECT cor_request_num, cor_content, TO_CHAR(cor_requestdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD')AS cor_requestdate, cor_status, memberIdx FROM ClubOwnerRequest WHERE memberIdx = #{memberIdx} ORDER BY cor_request_num DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ClubOwnerRequest WHERE cor_request_num = #{cor_request_num} AND memberIdx = #{memberIdx} AND cor_status = 2
